clue.text: Unfortunately responsible for carrying junior

parts.note: carrying something in your arms is holding it
the junior member of a family is the baby

explanation.surface: Someone is sadly saddled with the task of carrying a youngster about.
explanation.walkthrough: To be left holding the baby is an idiom for being stuck with a responsibility nobody else wants.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means being saddled with a burden or blame that others have dodged.

clue.text: Deflated and depressed after cancelled service

indicators.note: after places the word for depressed behind the tennis term

parts.note: in tennis a let is a serve that is void and replayed
feeling down is feeling depressed

explanation.surface: A tennis player feels flat and miserable after a serve is voided.
explanation.walkthrough: In tennis a LET is a serve clipping the net, which is cancelled and played again.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyre that is let down has had its air released, so it is flat.

clue.text: He and I lead

parts.note: the van is the vanguard, the lead position

explanation.surface: A claim that two people are in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivan is a man's first name, so a male person who could be called he.

clue.text: Travel widely to be successful

definitions.meaning: to get on well in life or a career

explanation.surface: Advice that seeing the world brings success.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means literally journeying to many spots and idiomatically doing well in life.

clue.text: They could enclose hospital borders

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital
edges are borders

explanation.surface: Fences that might surround the boundaries of a hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Hedges are rows of shrubs planted to fence in fields and gardens.

clue.text: Supports awful idler who can't mend his ways

parts.note: to back someone is to support them

indicators.note: the letters of idler are made awful, jumbled into a mess

explanation.surface: Someone who keeps defending a lazy person who never reforms.
explanation.definitionFit: A backslider is a person who relapses into old bad habits after promising to reform.

clue.text: Beer offered to new winger

parts.note: bitter is a British style of hoppy draught beer

explanation.surface: A pint is bought for the team's fresh wide player.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a football winger; it is a bird, something with wings.
explanation.definitionFit: A bittern is a wading marsh bird, and anything with wings can be called a winger in crosswords.

clue.text: See vineyard ruined, yet soldier on

indicators.note: the letters of see vineyard are ruined, wrecked into a new order

explanation.surface: Even though the vines are destroyed, keep going.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an exhortation to persevere and keep going despite setbacks.

clue.text: The way to be censured and beaten

parts.note: ST is the usual abbreviation for street, a way
to be rapped is to be rebuked or criticised

explanation.surface: A punishment scene: someone told off and then given a thrashing.
explanation.definitionFit: To strap someone is to beat them with a leather belt, so strapped means thrashed.

clue.text: Percentage that is made by gorgeous girl

parts.note: a cut is a share or percentage of the takings
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A lovely girl earns a commission on the deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutie is informal slang for an attractive young woman.

clue.text: Forsakes a firm friend and blunders badly

parts.note: to drop someone is to abandon them
a brick is a dated term for a reliable, loyal friend

explanation.surface: Someone ditches a loyal mate and makes a terrible mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Dropping a brick is a British idiom for making an embarrassing gaffe.

clue.text: Shark seen by man on board

definitions.meaning: a shark is a swindler or cheat
a piece on a chessboard, the castle

explanation.surface: A predatory fish is spotted by a sailor on the ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Rook means a cheat or fraudster, and also the chess piece shaped like a castle tower.

clue.text: Create a fuss to produce a landscape

definitions.meaning: to cause a public row or display of temper
literally to construct a view or setting

explanation.surface: An artist kicks up a storm in order to paint a view.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means throwing a tantrum in public; read literally it means fashioning a view or picture.

clue.text: Providing an opening in broadcasting

definitions.meaning: literally supplying an aperture or vent
making feelings widely known, airing them

explanation.surface: Someone gets a break into the radio and television business.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means expressing feelings openly; read literally it is supplying a hole for air.

clue.text: Worker surrounded by lots of roofing material

indicators.note: the worker's word sits inside the word for lots, which surrounds it

parts.note: piles means lots, a great many
an ant is the classic crossword worker

explanation.surface: A builder stands amid heaps of stuff for putting on a roof.
explanation.definitionFit: Pantiles are curved S-shaped clay tiles laid on roofs.

clue.text: Provisions for six plus seven initially

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
and means plus

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of the word seven

explanation.surface: Food supplies calculated for a group of thirteen.
explanation.definitionFit: Viands is an old word for food or victuals, items of provision.

clue.text: Made red canon supply cannon

indicators.note: read as the adverb of supple, the letters of red canon bend flexibly into a new order

explanation.surface: A churchman turned red with embarrassment providing artillery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supply' looks like a verb meaning provide, but it is the adverb of supple, the anagram signal; 'Made' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordnance is a collective term for artillery, big guns mounted on carriages.

clue.text: A foul-mouthed blonde causes concern

indicators.note: the mouth is the opening, so only the opening letter of the word foul is used

parts.note: fair hair is blonde hair

explanation.surface: A blonde with a dirty tongue is worrying people.
explanation.definitionFit: An affair is a matter or business, something that is one's concern.

clue.text: Enthusiast just sounding a trumpet blast

parts.note: a fan is an enthusiast

indicators.note: sounding means the word for just is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: fair means just or equitable

explanation.surface: A keen supporter merely blowing a trumpet.
explanation.definitionFit: A fanfare is a short ceremonial flourish played on brass instruments.

clue.text: Ministerial reply it's necessary to clarify

indicators.note: to clarify a muddle is to sort it out, so these letters are put in a new order

parts.note: taken as the letters of it is, with the S counted

explanation.surface: A minister's answer that needs explaining.
explanation.definitionFit: Priestly means relating to a minister of religion, a cleric.

clue.text: Sole support for pt instructor?

definitions.meaning: a sports shoe holds up the foot's sole
PT is physical training, so a coach of exercise

explanation.surface: Asking whether the lone breadwinner is a gym teacher.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainer is a running shoe and also a fitness coach.

clue.text: Fowl the French serve with shellfish

parts.note: a cock is a male fowl
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A chef presents chicken with a seafood accompaniment.
explanation.definitionFit: A cockle is an edible bivalve mollusc with a ribbed shell.

clue.text: Manage a sporting venue, only to hit rock bottom

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it
a ground is a stadium or pitch

explanation.surface: A club owner runs a stadium and ends up ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship runs aground when it strikes the seabed or rocks, getting stuck at the bottom.

clue.text: Save one port in Italy

parts.note: save in the sense except, which bar also means
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Rescue a single harbour town in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Bari is a seaport on the Adriatic coast of southern Italy.

clue.text: Second group to get broadcasting allocation

parts.note: a lot is a group or batch

explanation.surface: Another team is given airtime.
explanation.definitionFit: A slot is a scheduled time period assigned to a programme.

clue.text: Crack is all the rage

definitions.meaning: a fine crack in pottery glaze

explanation.surface: Cocaine is the latest fashionable thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Craze means a hairline crack in glaze and also a short-lived fad.

clue.text: Setting fire to brushwood

definitions.meaning: small sticks and twigs used to start a fire

explanation.surface: Someone is burning the undergrowth.
explanation.definitionFit: Kindling is the act of igniting and also the dry twigs used to light a fire.

clue.text: Best not to buy the inferior item

definitions.meaning: to best someone is to defeat them

definitions.text: not to buy the inferior item
definitions.meaning: read playfully, to choose the superior product rather than the worse one

explanation.surface: Shopping advice: steer clear of the cheaper, poorer product.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to defeat or outdo; read literally it means obtaining the superior one.
